scope: All 18 distributed screen replays pass across declared private profiles: 17 with their original environment and one with external link handlers disabled, preserving recorded files, keystrokes and screen assertions. There are 2245 screen assertions. External opener integration is not covered; GNU LESSTEST test mode and production mode remain separate.

replays.name: chinese1
replays.review: Recorded environment, input-file boundaries, all keystrokes and expected screen record structure reviewed. Ordinary navigation, searches, filters, headers, Unicode input, ANSI formatting and word wrapping. Fixture files are display data; no shell/editor commands or external link-opening keystrokes are selected.
